isolation.cpu_memory: Pinned runc; no KFD or DRI; CPU-only flag and env; Docker cpuset follows process affinity; up to 8 GiB cgroup hard limit and no swap.
isolation.mounts: Sandbox root and exact base/binary/model/runtime/sealed data are recursively read-only; search-only writable disposable flock file shadows .lock; build-only write access to its fresh private XDG data directory.
isolation.network: Docker network=none, no route, no daemon socket in child
isolation.sqlite: RW host connection on fresh init index only; checkpoint(TRUNCATE) then copy zero-byte WAL and valid 32 KiB SHM before sealing; SQLite FTS SELECT from the sealed read-only bind mount verified.

limits: Non-inference confinement probe and mocked controls only; native model init/search qualification and official cohort observations are separate. Existing score-custody and source-admission limits remain.

failed_qualification.cause: Pinned init produced native chunks but no merged codes/residuals. Native search's lazy mmap load failed at opening merged_codes.lock on the read-only index.

materialization_fix.implementation: After confined native init and before the payload seal, deterministically prepare native merged codes/residuals and matching manifests. This uses only fresh local index output, performs no model work, respects the existing build deadline, and records materialization.json in the task's private data_home. Keep vector payload, its coordination lock paths, runtime, model and source read-only during retrieval. Only the pre-existing disposable project .lock mount is writable.
materialization_fix.next: Restage adapter identity with the existing row packet preparation, then run a new publisher smoke with a fresh tiny fixture. Native query qualification is pending. No grant, packet, helper or retained smoke payload was changed by this fix.

next-plaid/src/index.rs.reason: MmapIndex loads native document lengths, computes padding as max minus last, and asks for merged codes and residuals before mapping either.

next-plaid/src/mmap.rs.reason: Both merge routines first try a matching manifest and expected NPY size. A miss opens an exclusive lock, then writes temp arrays and manifests. The materializer replicates NPY v1 header, plain chunk concatenation, row padding and JSON fields.

probe.docker: Read-only access to both merged files succeeded. Attempted writes to them and creation of either merge lock were refused.
probe.independent_numpy: Exact element equality to original chunk arrays and validated pinned dtype.

source_fast_path.manifest_checks: Chunk count, row count, document-length padding, metadata mtime, data dimensions and merged file sizes matched.

publisher_qualification.limits: Fresh separate fixture real init + immutable model query only; no official cohort score or custody acceptance.

colgrep/src/commands/init.rs.behavior: Use canonical checkout path, explicit local model, default read-only configuration load, and private index initialization.

colgrep/src/commands/search.rs.behavior: Emit a top-k JSON list, skip updates when externally locked, make stats writes best effort, preserve absolute checkout paths.

colgrep/src/config.rs.behavior: Absent configuration loads defaults without writes; explicit config save is separate.

colgrep/src/index/mod.rs.behavior: Skip auto-index when locked; ignore patterns are relative to checkout; SearchResult serializes unit and score.

colgrep/src/model.rs.behavior: Existing local model directory preempts hub access; lists expected model assets.

colgrep/src/onnx_runtime.rs.behavior: Version 1.23.0; forced CPU suppresses CUDA setup and explicit ORT_DYLIB_PATH preempts auto-download.

colgrep/src/parser/types.rs.behavior: JSON unit contains file, line and end_line.

next-plaid/src/filtering.rs.behavior: Metadata SQLite opens with journal_mode=WAL and the FTS reader reuses it.
